parameters.name: aliasLike
parameters.description: The plug-in alias. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The inbound or outbound direction. Valid values:
- OutBound: outbound.
- InBound: inbound.
- Both: both directions.

parameters.name: excludeBuiltinAiProxy
parameters.description: Specifies whether to exclude built-in plug-ins.

parameters.name: gatewayType
parameters.description: The gateway type filter. Currently, **AI** and **API** gateway types are supported.

parameters.name: installed
parameters.description: Specifies whether the plug-in is installed.

parameters.name: nameLike
parameters.description: The plug-in name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description:
The plug-in source. Valid values:
- HigressOfficial: Higress official.
- HigressCommunity: Higress community.
- Custom: custom.
